lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Situation contained.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll examine the remains of the Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's as we expected.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Each Rapture classification corresponds to a specific egg type.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The larger and more ornate the egg, the higher the rank of the Rapture inside.
... Which means that Leviathan has the technology to create enhanced fusions.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, that much is certain.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: She was lying through her teeth!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I wouldn't be so sure.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The best way to deceive someone is to use the truth as a smokescreen to hide what's actually important.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I don't think everything she's told us was a falsehood.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Rather, hidden under the layers of truth, there was something she didn't want us to know.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Hmm... Makes sense.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: But why would Leviathan want to hide the fact that

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: she knows how to create superior fusions?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She probably figured that if we caught her, we'd try to stop her.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: It looks to me like she's trying to create a Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That was my initial suspicion, but this process doesn't seem capable of producing a Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Fusing a Nikke and Rapture together isn't something that can happen so easily.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: That makes sense too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She could be attempting to mass-produce Tyrant-class Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Based on our conversation with her in the Crystal Region, the Four Beasts don't have any control over the Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Only after Behemoth transformed and grew larger was she able to manipulate them.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If size is a prerequisite for controlling Raptures, then Leviathan decidedly has no pull over them.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But those black snakes seemed to be entirely under her command.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think it's evident that Leviathan created them using the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Following that logic, these Raptures that are hatched from these eggs, being made from Dark Matter as well, would also follow her orders.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If she ends up being capable of mass-producing Tyrant-class Raptures, we won't be able to turn a blind eye to that.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: True again. If she could produce these things on a mass scale, we'd be in a world of trouble.
They mentioned wanting to strike at the Offsprings...

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: If the Four Beasts came calling with an army of Tyrant-class creatures in tow, even the Offsprings would be in a tough spot.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Fortunately, only one Tyrant Class has been confirmed so far,

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: and it can't move outside of Dark Matter, so it doesn't seem like a major threat for the time being.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... But that may change depending on what comes out of these eggs next.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: All right, let's keep going.
